patterns.note: Alternating dark and light background sections create visual rhythm and clear content segmentation throughout the page.
Large, bold sans-serif headings establish a strong hierarchy, complemented by a clean, readable sans-serif body text.
A high-contrast palette of deep charcoal, light grey, and a vibrant orange accent is used consistently for branding and calls to action.
Sections animate into view with a subtle fade-up effect as the user scrolls, enhancing content discovery.
A dedicated 'Programmes d'aides' section uses a visual diagram to explain complex offerings, breaking down information into digestible steps.

technique_notes: Sections are revealed using a staggered fade-up animation as they enter the viewport, likely orchestrated with JavaScript or CSS keyframes.
The hero background image employs a subtle parallax scrolling effect, moving slower than the foreground content to add depth.
The main navigation bar sticks to the top of the viewport after a short scroll, maintaining persistent access to key links.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) create strong visual impact, with a clear hierarchy down to readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., ~4-8px) are applied consistently to buttons, input fields, and card elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing throughout, with airy padding in the hero and section breaks, transitioning to a more balanced density in content grids and forms.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a moody, cinematic hero image with a strong dark overlay and a single vibrant orange accent immediately sets a sophisticated and professional tone. This high-contrast approach, combined with clean typography, elevates the brand beyond typical corporate insurance sites.
